disable_progress_bars: disable progress bars globally or for a specified group name
enable_progress_bars: enable progress bars globally or for a specified group name
are_progress_bars_disabled: check if progress bars are disabled globally or for a specific group
tqdm_stream_file: stream a file with a progress bar showing bytes read during upload
_get_progress_bar_context: create a context manager for a tqdm progress bar with configurable options
